answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 88 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 16 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 88 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 626 sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the summit here is verification, the voyage of cost is what stops the farm, and the thread of the record keeps every claim checkable.
